name: Bobbleheads
blurb: Every bobblehead spawn point in Fallout 76 — 683 placed points across 270 map markers, each with a 20% chance of holding one. Pick a region for its full spawn list, or read on for the boxes, vendors and events that hand bobbleheads over.

world_spawns.note: Each placed point rolls the LPI_Loot_Bobbleheads list, whose ChanceNone is driven by the LPI_Chance_BobbleHeads_ECON economy global (currently 80.0). Which bobblehead you get is a separate even roll across the 21-item pool.

containers.note: opening a Bobblehead Box — also from the Glowing Bobblehead Box, Milepost Zero scavenger, Milepost Zero scavenger (bobblehead pool). Bobblehead boxes are handed out by the Scoreboard, Giuseppe the Stamp Vendor, public events, the Gleaming Depths raid and the U Mine It treasure maps rather than found in world containers.
